task.title: Make package audit discover skill assets from pi.skills
task.summary: Patch the package audit to inspect package-declared Pi skill assets instead of requiring CodeWiki-specific skills/codewiki paths.

goal.outcome: Package audit is package-neutral for Pi skills and no longer emits CodeWiki skill false positives against packages such as ThinkCode.
acceptance: auditPackage reads package.json pi.skills entries and discovers actual skill assets under those entries.
Package audit no longer hardcodes skills/codewiki/** as required package artifacts.
Discovered real skill assets are required to exist and to appear in npm pack --dry-run output.
A smoke test covers a non-CodeWiki skill package with skills/think-code/SKILL.md.
non_goals: Redesign all package manifest checks unrelated to skill assets.

delta.desired: Package audit derives required skill assets from package.json pi.skills and discovered skill directories/files.
delta.current: Package audit hardcodes skills/codewiki skill assets and reports false positives for other Pi packages.
